title: MACBETH (NDSF 2026)
location: DeBartolo Performing Arts Center | DeBartolo Performing Arts Center, 100 Performing Arts Center | Notre Dame, 46556
description: Shakespeare at Notre Dame Ambition o'erleaps itself in Shakespeare's "Scottish Play," where the throne is for the taking. Claimed in blood, a Scottish general now wears the crown but must suffer the consequences of fate, influence, and greed. "Macbeth" is an examination of power, what it takes to obtain, and what it costs to keep. "Macbeth" is brought to life by the Notre Dame Shakespeare Festival's Professional Company, under the direction of Matt Hawkins, Director of Theatre and Musical Theatre for the Department of Film, Television, and Theatre at the University of Notre Dame. Murder, mutiny, and mystery set the tone for one of Shakespeare's greatest dramatic achievements. This always-relevant examination of the lacerating effects of the reckless desire for power unfolds in the Scottish highlands. A poisonous cocktail of ambition, guilt, and paranoia, with subtle seasonings of the supernatural, the show explores conflicted characters with the twists and turns of a riveting thriller. Event includes mature or adult content.

title: SCAVENGER HUNT AT THE MORRIS
location: The Morris Performing Arts Center | 211 N Michigan St | South Bend, IN 46601
description:
Experience the Morris Performing Arts Center like never before! Join Connect 574 for an interactive scavenger hunt that takes you behind the scenes and throughout the venue as you solve clues and discover fascinating facts about the historic building.

Whether you’re a first-time visitor or a longtime patron, this adventure is a great way to connect with others and learn more about a defining South Bend landmark. Gather your own team or have us create one for you, put your detective skills to the test, and see if you can complete the hunt before time runs out!

Where: Morris Performing Arts Center

When: August 21 at 6:30

Event Highlights:

No awkward intros: we’ll introduce you to your team and help break the ice – or if you’d like to sign up with friends, that’s okay too!

Get to know a South Bend landmark: The Morris has been part of our skyline for over 100 years, and has a lot of fascinating history inside.

Welcome hour: We’ll have a cash bar for you to get comfortable when you come in!

title: THE ART OF CIGAR ROLLING: A MASTERCLASS EXPERIENCE
location: Jackson's Cigars & Spirits | 100 N Center St #40 | Mishawaka, IN 46544
description:
Experience the Art of Cigar Rolling at Jackson’s Cigars & Spirits

Ever wondered what it takes to turn a tobacco leaf into a premium, hand-rolled cigar? On August 20, Jackson’s Cigars & Spirits in Mishawaka is bringing the craft to life with a special evening featuring a La Galera cigar representative and live cigar rolling demonstration.

Event Features

Live La Galera cigar rolling demonstration

Fresh hand-rolled cigars

La Galera cigar specials

Crafted cigar-pairing cocktails

Enter to win a La Galera Year of the Horse Limited Edition Gift Set

Buy 4 cigars and receive the raffle entry

Watch the process firsthand as tobacco leaves are selected, prepared and expertly rolled into finished cigars. Guests will have the opportunity to experience a fresh hand-rolled cigar while learning more about the craftsmanship and tradition behind La Galera cigars.

Throughout the evening, enjoy La Galera cigar specials, handcrafted cocktails designed to pair with your cigar, and raffle giveaways. Purchase four cigars and get one free, and enter for a chance to win the La Galera Year of the Horse Limited Edition Box.

Whether you’re a longtime cigar enthusiast or simply curious about how a cigar is made, this is a rare opportunity to see the craft up close in the relaxed, upscale atmosphere of Jackson’s Cigars & Spirits.
